metadata.name: Daytake Landing Page
metadata.description: An editorial photography landing page with a scroll-controlled 3D hero, opposing photo rows, an expanding feature image, floating widgets, and SVG-connected creator cards. Responsive light and dark layouts include pause controls and a reduced-motion fallback.
